page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, ensuring dedicated physical execution resources for each virtual processor without hyperthreading.

This instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8 and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs focuses its qualitative cost efficiency on workloads requiring substantial memory capacity and dedicated compute threads without accelerator overhead. Suitable workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, and enterprise applications requiring high memory capacity and predictable CPU performance.
